descriptions.w3d_wind_dispatch_80130320: Handles wind-display creation and visibility messages, forwarding other messages to the base.
descriptions.w3d_wind_update_ratio_80130d1c: Updates the wind ratio, refreshes changed graphics and adjusts timing when visibility changes.
descriptions.w3d_wind_ratio_80130dd4: Returns the current wind speed divided by the maximum wind speed.
descriptions.w3d_wind_digits_80130e24: Computes the displayed wind value and writes its tens and units mesh indices.
descriptions.w3d_wind_clear_animation_80130f78: Clears the wind mesh animation control and resets the stored control identifier.
descriptions.w3d_wind_direction_80131520: Returns a direction vector using the sine and cosine of the held direction value.
descriptions.w3d_wind_set_visible_801315a0: Applies the supplied visibility value to the three wind-display resources.
descriptions.w3d_motion_message_construct_80131a84: Initializes a motion message with its cached identifier, vectors, timing and method member.
